title: 第25章 天玄鹰劲第26章 已有取死之道
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 步入内院。
积雪被踩得嘎吱作响。
梅霜风在空旷的院子中央站定，转身面向二人。
“武道一途，犹如平地起高楼。站桩是打熬气血，夯实地基；等地基固若金汤了，才能再往上走，去练‘技法’。”
“但想要催动技法，就必须配以特殊的呼吸法门。”
“我梅氏这套『玄鹰桩』，内含一整套暗劲级的呼吸法，以及三十六路完整打法，名唤…『天玄鹰劲』！”
梅霜风负手而立，看着沈修寒，道：“这门功夫不讲虚的，只认八个字，拆骨拔筋，一招见血！练它，就是为了杀人！”
沈修寒眼皮一跳。
果不其然，和他在推演中领悟出的功夫分毫不差。
“徐川，起势！”
徐川面皮一紧，大步跨出，双臂交错，严丝合缝护住中门。
“看好了！”
字音未落，梅霜风周身煞气宛如实质般轰然炸开。
脚下一错，整条右臂如抡圆的铁鞭，高高扬起，狠狠劈落！
五指如铁钩内扣，撕裂寒风发出一声锐啸，直奔徐川锁骨后方的肩井大穴凿了下去。
哧！
一声骨节错位的闷响。
徐川架子端得再严实，身子还是不受控制往下塌，整条右臂当即疼得软成了面条，重心被撕碎，胸前瞬间空门大开。
“这招叫‘裂石分筋’，冲着废人膀子去的。”
“轻拿让人脱力，重扣直接卸掉肩胛。”
“精髓在于专打他必救的软肋，一招拔掉还手之力！”
徐川龇牙咧嘴，尚未缓过气来，梅霜风的左手已如毒蛇吐信，毫无征兆蹿了出去！
指尖发出尖锐的呼啸，直插徐川气管！
沈修寒瞳孔猛地一缩。
『玄鹰夺魄』！
是『天玄鹰劲』里的杀招之一，专撕人死穴。
徐川惊出一身冷汗，仓皇间抬起左臂，架在脖颈前。
哧！
梅霜风手腕如无骨，诡异一翻，贴着徐川小臂内侧滑入，抠在喉结下的天突穴上，只要再往里送半寸，喉骨就会被捏爆！
“咕咚！”
徐川咽了口唾沫，黄豆大的冷汗顺着下巴不住往下砸。
content_en:
Enter the inner courtyard.
The snow crunched underfoot.
Mei Shuangfeng stood in the middle of the empty courtyard and turned to face the two of them.
"The journey of martial arts is like building a tall building from flat ground. Zhanzhuang is to build up the energy and blood and lay a solid foundation. Only when the foundation is solid can we go up and practice the 'techniques'."
"But if you want to activate the technique, you must use a special breathing method."
"My Mei clan's set of 'Xuan Ying Jing' contains a complete set of dark-level breathing techniques and thirty-six complete fighting methods. It's called...'Tian Xuan Ying Jin'!"
Mei Shuangfeng stood with her hands behind her back, looked at Shen Xiuhan, and said: "This kung fu is not empty, it only recognizes eight characters, removes bones and pulls out tendons, and sees blood with one move! Practice it just to kill people!"
Shen Xiuhan's eyelids twitched.
As expected, it was exactly the same as what he had learned during the deduction.
"Xuchuan, get up!"
"Yes!"
Xu Chuan's face tightened, and he strode out with his arms crossed to protect the middle door.
"Watch it!"
Before the sound of the word fell, the evil energy around Mei Shuangfeng exploded like a substance.
With one wrong step, his entire right arm was raised high like a round iron whip and fell down hard!
The five fingers were like iron hooks clasping inside, tearing through the cold wind and letting out a sharp roar, then went straight to the Jianjing point behind Xu Chuan's collarbone and dug into it.
Chi!
There was a muffled sound of dislocated joints.
No matter how tightly Xu Chuan held himself up, his body still collapsed uncontrollably. His entire right arm was so painful that it turned into a noodle. His center of gravity was torn to pieces, and his chest was instantly wide open.
"This move is called 'Split the Stone and Split the Tendons', and it's aimed at the disabled person's arms."
"Gently lifting it will take away the strength, and pressing it hard will directly remove the shoulder blades."
"The essence is to hit his weak points that are bound to be saved, and remove the power to fight back with one move!"
Xu Chuan bared his teeth and before he could catch his breath, Mei Shuangfeng's left hand was already spitting out a message like a poisonous snake, leaping out without any warning!
The fingertips made a sharp whistling sound and penetrated into Xu Chuan's trachea!
Shen Xiuhan's pupils shrank suddenly.
"Xuanying seizes the soul"!
It is one of the killing moves in "Tian Xuan Ying Jin", which is designed to tear people's fatal points.
Xu Chuan broke into a cold sweat and hurriedly raised his left arm and put it in front of his neck.
Chi!
Mei Shuangfeng's wrist seemed to be boneless, and it turned strangely, sliding it in against the inside of Xu Chuan's forearm, and digging into the Tiantu point under the Adam's apple. As long as it went in half an inch further, the throat bone would be crushed!
"Gudong!"
Xu Chuan swallowed, and cold sweat dripped down his chin.
